name: Vesopa Go
subtitle: Orders & payments, anywhere
promotional_text: Seat a table, send the order to the kitchen and take the payment, all from your phone, with everything in the same Vesopa back office as your tills.
description:
Vesopa Go puts your Vesopa EPOS till in your pocket. Take orders and payments anywhere in the venue, at the counter, at the table or out on the terrace, and everything lands in the same back office as your tills.

At the table
• See the floor plan live: which tables are seated, ordering, waiting or paying
• Seat a table, add covers and order from the venue's real menu, with modifiers, choices and allergens
• Send to the kitchen in one tap; courses are fired when you say
• Open bills are shared with the tills: start a bill on the phone, finish it at the bar, or the other way round

At the counter
• A quick, clear sell screen for bars, cafés, pop-ups and events
• Quick sale for a typed amount
• Cash with change shown, or card

Card payments
• Send the payment to the venue's card machine (Dojo, Stripe Terminal or Teya), with tips and split bills
• QR Pay: the customer scans a code and pays the bill on their own phone, by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay
• Every step of a card payment on screen, with a clear result and another way to pay if a card is declined
• Refunds need a manager's PIN, every time

Kitchen screens and customer displays
• An iPad can be the kitchen board: every ticket the same size, oldest first, allergens and notes in plain sight
• Or the customer display: the bill as it is rung up, the total, how to pay, and your own adverts when it is quiet
• Connect a screen by scanning the code it shows, and drive it from your phone

Live and fast
• A live connection to the back office: orders, bills, the kitchen and menu changes arrive the moment they happen
• Keeps working through a dropped signal and sends the sales when it is back

Sales and reports
• Today's receipts, emailed receipts and refunds
• The day's takings by payment type and category, and End of day

Secure sign-in
• Sign in with your venue's Vesopa account, then staff use their own PIN, staff card or Face ID

New to Vesopa? Register your venue in the app and start a 14-day free trial, or tap Try the demo to look round first.

review.notes: Vesopa Go is the phone and tablet app for venues that use Vesopa EPOS: orders at the table and the counter, sent to the kitchen, paid by card, QR code or cash, with every sale in the venue's Vesopa back office. No sign-in is needed to review it: on the first screen tap Try the demo, then sign on with staff PIN 1111 (Sam, a manager; 2222 and 3333 are staff). The demo venue runs on the device alone and its payments are pretend, so no real money moves. A real venue signs in with its Vesopa account (Continue with Vesopa) or registers in the app (Register a new venue), where Stripe checks the owner's identity and business. Card payments in a real venue are taken by the venue's payment provider: Tap to Pay on iPhone through Stripe Terminal where it is switched on for the venue, or the venue's Dojo, Stripe or Teya card machine. The app never reads or stores card numbers.
